home.eyebrow: ATLAS OPERATING SYSTEM FOR REPETITIVE WORK
home.title: Turn repetitive work into workflows that actually run.
home.lead: Start with a proven template, connect the tools you already use, and let supervised AI handle the repetitive work. Every outbound action waits for human approval, and every step is recorded with visible cost.
home.canvasCaption: Execution Simulation: Inbound Lead Qualification (Run #281 • Rp 71 • Completed)
home.proofPillars: 120+ BUSINESS WORKFLOWS • CONTROLLED AI • REAL EXECUTION • VISIBLE COST • AUDITABLE RESULTS
home.stepsTitle: From concept to running in four steps
home.step1d: Start from 120+ proven business workflow architectures customized to your operational requirements.
home.step2d: Configure scoring thresholds, operational channels, and team approval policies without coding.
home.step3d: Run secure scenario simulations to verify every step and routing logic prior to live launch.
home.step4d: Monitor active workflows, team approval queues, and operational turnaround in real-time.
home.controlTitle: Your team approves, the system executes
home.controlBody: Outbound client messages, price quotes, and CRM updates pause at approval gates. Drafts are reviewed before dispatch.
home.costBody: Intelligent architecture eliminates up to 80% of repetitive manual effort with transparent, predictable budgeting.
home.traceBody: Every interaction is permanently and immutably recorded for compliance, transparency, and operational governance.
home.comparisonTitle: Why Conventional AI Chatbots Risk Enterprise Operations
home.comparisonSubtitle: Open-ended chatbots are designed for casual dialogue. Business operations require deterministic execution, human approval gates, and compliance standards.
home.chatPoint1: Unfiltered hallucination risks sending false quotes directly to clients
home.chatPoint2: Unstructured conversational outputs that fail to sync with enterprise CRMs
home.chatPoint3: Unpredictable per-transaction token expenses that inflate over time
home.chatPoint4: Ephemeral chat histories without regulatory compliance audit trails
home.chatPoint5: Constant repetitive manual firefighting whenever incorrect responses occur
home.wfPoint1: Mandatory human approval gate before any external message or action executes
home.wfPoint2: Multi-tier data validation ensures zero corrupted records enter pipelines
home.wfPoint3: High operational efficiency delivering measurable and auditable business ROI
home.wfPoint4: Permanent immutable event audit trail for regulatory and compliance review
home.wfPoint5: Isolated workflow execution with strict client privacy and data sovereignty
home.agencyTitle: Scalable Architecture for Multi-Account & Multi-Brand Operations
home.agencySubtitle: Designed for enterprises and agencies managing multiple departments, branches, or client accounts under unified governance.
home.agencyPoint1Body: Every business unit or client account maintains an isolated environment with strict privacy boundaries.
home.agencyPoint2Body: Eliminate 80% of routine administrative tasks so your team can focus on client closing and strategic service.
home.agencyPoint3Body: Rapid deployment using battle-tested foundations across 12 commercial industries.
home.industriesSubtitle: Dedicated workflow solutions specifically engineered for each industry's operational realities.
home.pricingSubtitle: Choose a complimentary discovery audit, a 5-day turnkey implementation sprint, or ongoing managed operations.
home.planFreeDesc: Basic workflow testing and preview access
home.planAgencyDesc: Multi-brand governance and priority SLA support
home.dfyAuditDesc: 30-minute diagnostic mapping bottlenecks and projected ROI
home.dfySprintDesc: Fully integrated turnkey workflow deployed in 5 business days
home.dfyRetainerDesc: Ongoing maintenance, routine optimization, and dedicated specialist support
home.finalBody: Consult your operational workflows with our automation engineers or schedule a complimentary diagnostic audit.

pricing.title: Investment Packages & Implementation Services
pricing.lead: Predictable investments to automate your business operations with guaranteed outcomes, strict confidentiality, and dedicated enterprise support.
pricing.sprintBody: 1 fully integrated custom production workflow, channel wiring, team training, and 14 days of dedicated monitoring.
pricing.auditBody: In-depth diagnostic mapping operational bottlenecks, projected time savings, and a tailored workflow blueprint.
pricing.careBody: Ongoing maintenance, regular workflow optimizations, 24/7 system health monitoring, and a dedicated solutions engineer.
pricing.aiNote: Confidentiality & Compliance: All implementations are protected by a mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). Your proprietary data remains exclusively yours and is never used to train third-party AI models.

security.title: Security, Confidentiality & Data Compliance
security.lead: Enterprise-grade architecture protecting your proprietary business data across every stage of workflow execution.
security.i1d: Your proprietary business information is legally protected under a formal NDA prior to any implementation kickoff.
security.i2d: Every workspace is strictly isolated on the server side with zero cross-tenant data bleed.
security.i3d: External dispatches and customer communications require explicit sign-off from your authorized operators.
security.i4d: Idempotent execution guarantees zero duplicate dispatches or recurring actions during network retries.
security.i5d: All data transmissions and operational records are secured with industry-standard cryptographic encryption.
security.i6d: Your proprietary business inputs and transactions are guaranteed never to train public AI models.
security.contact: Contact our security and compliance team for internal audit reviews.
